data.content: ["Perfect for a relaxed outdoor escape with scenic hikes and natural beauty that respects your group's no-early-mornings schedule and outdoor focus, though you'll need to plan Italian dining in nearby towns.", "Offers iconic outdoor adventures and stunning scenic drives ideal for your outdoor-focused group's relaxed pace, though Italian restaurants and cultural activities will require travel to gateway towns like Flagstaff.", "Delivers low-cost, scenic badlands exploration with flexible hiking that fits your relaxed schedule and outdoor preference, though limited dining and cultural options mean planning meals and museums ahead of time.", "Combines affordable outdoor recreation and scenic walks through dramatic landscapes at your preferred relaxed pace, but lacks the Italian dining and urban amenities Bob and Carol desire without traveling to nearby towns.", "Provides budget-friendly, unique badlands scenery and peaceful exploration perfect for your outdoor-focused group's relaxed schedule, though it's the most remote option with minimal dining and cultural facilities nearby."]
